deviations: REPAIR ROUND (verifier flags addressed): (a) HarnessActivity.handleLaunchIntent runs from onCreate AND onNewIntent (setIntent + re-parse); live-instance launches without extras or during an active run are logged loudly ('LAUNCH REFUSED (loud)...'), never silently ignored; (b) SystemDialogAutoDismiss — the a11y service detect-and-taps the platform ANR dialog's Wait button (rootInActiveWindow package 'android' + android:id/aerr_wait|button1) on every warm-up step and readiness poll; (c) warm-up and starvation retries cold-start the browser (GLOBAL_ACTION_HOME -> KILL_BACKGROUND_PROCESSES -> navigate) so the WebView initializes with a11y enabled; KILL_BACKGROUND_PROCESSES permission added; (d) starvation retry: up to 2 retries (3 attempts) only for the loop's unreadable-tree REFUSED detail or HARNESS_ERROR — genuine refusals (unreadable-1, expected REFUSED) are never retried; reports record attempts + flakeRetried (RunReport schema extended; defaults keep old reports decodable); (e) logGaps = steps - rows - metaDecisions in the loop (rephrase meta-decisions excluded by definition; documented on RunResult.logGaps and RunReport.logGaps; rephrase test now asserts logGaps 0 / metaDecisions 1).

ActionDisposition gained ONE additive value, 'refused-by-guard' (@SerialName "refused-by-guard") in :core DecisionLogModels.kt: the loop's ART-4 refusal of the engine's self-reported finish (noul HIGH but guard unsatisfied, or noul not HIGH) had no honest vocabulary in the Phase-5 set (executed/refused-by-owner/gate-timeout/task-aborted all misdescribe a code-side guard refusal). Additive only — earlier rows decode unchanged; recorded in core/AGENTS.md log law.

Recovery-set 'rephrase' (StuckDetector L2) is a deterministic stub until Phase 10 (phase doc scope): it rewrites the working goal text via phraseStub (first quoted span of the goal), performs no gesture, and logs NO DecisionLogRow — it is a goal-text meta-decision tracked as RunResult.metaDecisions and in HISTORY, because every LoggedActionKind implies a page action. 'give-up' DOES log a row (FINISH/EXECUTED/EXITED). logGaps excludes metaDecisions (see repair round), so gaps stay 0 on rephrase runs.

Graceful refusal (vision 03 §5 'I can't read this site') and triage 'impossible' (vision 04 §1) are recorded as their own TerminalState values (REFUSED, TRIAGE_IMPOSSIBLE) alongside vision 04 §3's five exits — the vision's exit list covers navigation-phase endings; these two abort before/without navigation. The vision-03 'root walk fails twice' rule is generalized into a configurable patience: refuseAfterUnusableReads=20 fresh reads @1.5s (~30s) because page loads on a loaded emulator transiently drop the Chromium a11y subtree; genuinely unreadable pages (unreadable-1) still refuse, just later.

Unusable-tree judgment uses the WebView-subtree node count (pageNodeCount, from the service's observeForLoop() walk: descendants under the first WebView-classed node) in addition to the >=5-meaningful-nodes rule, so browser toolbar nodes cannot make a canvas-only page look readable (vision 03 §5's 'one undifferentiated node'). Phase 1's frozen Observation shape was untouched; a separate LoopObservation type was added.

Budget spend prices are pinned placeholders in code (SpendPrices: $3/1M input, $15/1M output, 256-token output estimate per call) because the repo records no provider price sheet; input tokens counted with the real laya tokenizer, output estimated (the wire contract carries no usage field). All arithmetic integer micro-dollars (ART-5). STUB runs record zero tokens = $0 exactly, as evidenced in every run report.

The risk-gate needs SUBMIT-kind actions for its H1/H3/H4 submission paths; a tap maps to SUBMIT when the candidate label/id matches submit/search/go/send (SUBMIT_TRAP regex in the loop) — code-side classification only, consistent with Phase 4's fail-to-confirm law.

On-device Gate 6.2 used org.chromium.webview_shell (Phase-1-sanctioned allowlist fallback; the AVD ships no Chrome stable) driven against the harness's own loopback static server (HarnessPagesServer, bound to 127.0.0.1:8099, serving assets/harness/pages/) — 'static local test page' per the gate, no host tooling needed; INTERNET permission + <queries> visibility for the two allowlisted browsers added to the manifest for LIVE mode and browser discovery.

Emulator flakiness mitigations that live in the harness (not the loop): bounded warm-up with browser cold-start (see repair round); per-goal readiness waits for the goal's own URL + a real content subtree; starvation retries (repair round). The deterministic runbook for a Gate 6.2 re-run: boot headless -> settings put enabled_accessibility_services + accessibility_enabled=1 (+ show_ime_with_hard_keyboard 0) -> 'am start -S navigator.app/.harness.HarnessActivity --es goal all --es engine stub --ez autoDeny true' -> re-put the two settings after -S (it clears them) -> cold-start the browser while the service is bound (the harness now does this itself) -> poll run-reports/suite-report.json -> pull -> kill emulator. Any residual ANR dialog is auto-dismissed by the harness; manual 'tap Wait' is no longer required.

Kotlin/gradle: :app added the kotlinx-serialization plugin (Phase 6 declares @Serializable harness/report types — first :app-local serializables) and an implementation copy of kotlinx-coroutines (the loop is suspend-first; :core keeps coroutines internal). Both already-versioned catalog entries.

DebugGatePresenter requires the owner-granted SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW permission to float over Chrome; without it, it falls back to an activity-local dialog. This is the harness gate stand-in only (phase doc §2.1); the product overlay is Phase 9.
